persona.prefix: You are an OMP-style coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
persona.suffix: Your working directory is {{cwd}}. Verify your work by running it. Keep answers brief and factual.

modes.label: Plan
modes.summary: Read-only investigation that ends in a decision-complete plan.
modes.description: Launches in a read-only sandbox: file mutations are unavailable and risky actions still ask first. dsh keeps the tool catalog stable across modes, so the OMP plan preset also carries the plan-mode section; press /plan inside the session to enter it. Mirrors OMP's plan mode.

modes.label: Build
modes.summary: The full OMP coding agent inside the workspace.
modes.description: Launches in a workspace-write sandbox: bash and filesystem mutations stay inside the session workspace, and anything risky asks first. This is the default mode.

modes.label: YOLO
modes.summary: The full OMP coding agent with no confinement and no prompts.
modes.description: Launches with danger-full-access and never-ask approval. Mirrors OMP's auto-approve mode; use only in throwaway workspaces.
